notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood for inference layer. Started on Hosted API (quick PoC for embeddings + chat) -> satisfied accuracy but saw token cost and throughput variability. Now moving to Dedicated POC to meet predictable latency and throughput for product-facing assistants.

Key asks from Verdant:
- Stable p95 latency < 350ms for small-chat flows; p50 < 150ms preferred.
- 20–50 qps sustained for reranking pipelines (batching ok).
- Deterministic cost for budgeting — want reserved capacity + overage pricing.
- Data residency: primary US, some EU customers require EU region pinning.
- Security: SSO (SAML), SOC2 evidence, audit logging, KMS for model keys.

POC scope (agreed on 2026-03-02 call ff_20260302_security_review):
- 4-week Dedicated POC (reserved GPU pool) + Redwood console access.
- Canary rollout plan: start with 5% traffic -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% over 10 business days. Canary tests driven by synthetic and shadow traffic.
- Fallback routing: model variant hierarchy + region failover. Primary route: quantized v1 (cost-optimized) in us-east. If quality/regressions or capacity hit, fallback to fp16 v0 in us-east; if entire region degraded, failover to us-west eu-west replicas (region preference set per customer segment).
- Rollback triggers: sustained p50 latency > 200ms increase vs baseline, p95 > 400ms, or error rate > 1% for 10m. Automatic rollback to previous healthy model variant + alert to SE/ops.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-model latency heatmaps, diffed evals against baseline prompt set.

POC acceptance criteria (customer):
- Latency SLOs met 95% of time for target flows.
- No production-quality regressions on a 200-prompt eval set (quality delta <= 2%).
- Predictable cost within 10% of estimate during POC.
- Successful canary + automated rollback demo documented in runbook.

Notes from calls: "We like the hosted experience — now we need guarantees for customer-facing workloads. Pricing flexibility and ability to pin EU residency are deal-breakers." (VP Product).

Legal/security: security questionnaire returned 2026-03-01; need KMS integration diagram and SOC2 mapping doc. (Drive refs above).

Pricing: draft term sheet provided 2026-03-04; customer asking for 12-month reserved commit with right-to-scale clause. AE/Jordan to surface to RevOps.

Quick wins / internal tasks: provision test VPC peering, create canary playbook (runbook id: INF-7421), schedule load-gen for reranker test (2026-03-10).
